Pixel Palette

Generate harmonious color palettes. Lock colors to keep them.

# Pixel Color Palette Generator

A simple offline browser app that generates harmonious 5-color palettes with hex codes. Lock individual colors to keep them across generations.

## Features

- Generates a new harmonious palette of 5 colors
- Displays hex code for each color
- Lock toggle on each swatch to preserve that color
- Keyboard accessible controls with visible focus states
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide
- No external dependencies, works completely offline

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. Click **Generate New Palette** to create a new set of colors. Click the lock icon on any swatch to keep that color when generating a new palette.

## Files

- `index.html` — main page structure
- `styles.css` — styling and responsive layout
- `script.js` — palette generation and lock logic

## Color Harmony

The generator uses HSL color space with three harmony schemes:

1. Analogous (30° increments)
2. Triadic (120° increments)
3. Split-complementary (45° increments)

Saturation and lightness are randomized within a pleasant range.

## Accessibility

- All controls are keyboard accessible
- Lock buttons have `aria-pressed` state and descriptive labels
- Status messages are announced via `aria-live`
- Focus indicators are visible on all interactive elements
